svg.title: Diagram 9. Deployment and trust boundaries for Bottle: device, Databricks account and workspaces, browser and IdP
svg.desc: Three trust zones for Bottle. Zone 1 is the device: WebView windows hold no secrets and the hidden brain hosts T12 ConsentService; the Rust core secret boundary holds CLI access tokens, the SQLCipher key and journal keys in memory only, plus the native REC indicator and the native consent dialog of R11; the OS keychain holds the CLI token cache (CLI 1.17 or later); local disk holds the encrypted SQLite memory store (MVP, BC2) and the session journal; the main agents get no token. Zone 2 is the Databricks account with workspace A (Unity Gateway, Genie One MCP, UC Pages drafts, optional v1 Lakebase) and workspace B. Zone 3 is the browser and IdP. Numbered flows show the data that crosses each boundary; flow 5 is v1 only. The MVP admin prerequisites need a genie_one_mcp QPM of 40 or more per user, or no limit and no Lakebase.
svg.text: Diagram 9. Deployment and trust boundaries: where tokens live and which data crosses each boundary
Trust zone 1: Device running Bottle (macOS 14.4+ / Windows 11)
WebView windows (hub, MOG views, cards, hidden brain)
Holds: cleaned text, blurbs, mood, MOG config (no secrets)
T12 ConsentService (brain): notice, attestation, records
CSP: no external connect-src; Rive asset CDN off
Events only, never a key · panels never contentProtected
R12 IpcGateway: schema + scrubbing
Rust core · secret boundary: no token crosses
In memory only (zeroised on 401, sleep, sign-out):
• CLI access token per profile (≤ 60 min, refresh −60 s)
• v1 only: Lakebase credential, new per connection
• SQLCipher key and per-session journal DEK
• a token goes only to its own host; agents (BC4) get none
Native REC indicator
fail-closed: no indicator,
no capture; visible in
screen share; pause
closes the mic
Native consent dialog
(R11 WindowHost) shows
what T12 asks; T12
keeps records 13 months
(content-free)
OS keychain (secure storage)
• CLI token cache (U2M refresh + access), CLI ≥ 1.17
• SQLCipher key and journal KEK (this device only)
• plaintext CLI storage gives a blocking warning (D39)
Local disk (encrypted)
• SQLite memory store (BC2): SQLCipher, WAL, FTS5, sqlite-vec
• Session journal: AEAD Ogg-Opus, new file every 60 s,
crypto-shred ≤ 5 min after transcript commit
databricks CLI ≥ 1.17
subprocess, absolute
path, clean env
Mic (You) + system audio
(Others, MVP-M); mic closed
when idle; zero-buffer
check at 5 s
Trust zone 2: Databricks account (customer tenancy)
Account OAuth apps
• databricks-cli published app (default U2M client)
• optional custom public app via auth login --client-id (S)
Workspace A (home profile)
Unity Gateway model services (/ai-gateway/mlflow/v1)
system.ai.* names; FMAPI may keep inputs ≤ 30 d (abuse)
Genie One MCP ?o=<workspace_id A>
Genie history, audit and query history keep questions
Lakebase project: optional v1 sync (BC2), PITR 2 d
v1: items, sessions, summary + key numbers + pointer
UC Pages DRAFTs (BC3, scope knowledge); usage: tags only
Workspace B (target profile)
Genie One MCP ?o=<workspace_id B>
token B only; conversations stay pinned to B
memory stores a pointer only for B answers (MEM-25)
Admin prerequisites (ADM)
• Genie One on; EXECUTE on system.ai.genie_one_mcp
• USE CATALOG system, USE SCHEMA system.ai
• egress port 443; Lakebase and 5432 are v1 only (BC2)
• model services granted; cross-geo routing if needed
• genie_one_mcp MCP QPM ≥ 40 per user, or no limit
• MDM keys; custom OAuth app scopes incl. knowledge
Trust zone 3: Browser / corporate IdP
SSO for databricks auth login (OAuth U2M, loopback redirect)
① audio ≤ 30 s chunks (cloud ASR only)
① audio ≤ 30 s chunks (cloud ASR only)
② text: cleanup, classifier, embed, agent
② text: cleanup, classifier, embed, agent
③ question + approved preamble ≤ 800
③ question + approved preamble ≤ 800
④ progress, answer (serial polls)
④ progress, answer (serial polls)
⑤ v1 only: sync items · TLS 5432
⑤ v1 only: sync items · TLS 5432
⑥ question to B; no A context by default
⑥ question to B; no A context by default
⑦ auth login: SSO in browser, OAuth code back to the CLI
⑦ auth login: SSO in browser, OAuth code back to the CLI
Legend
Device
Rust core (secret)
WebView window
Databricks workspace
Lakebase (v1)
OS services
Browser / IdP
Account boundary
request / data
event / stream
credential fetch
① to ⑦ = data that crosses
Never crosses a boundary (default)
• tokens, Lakebase password or keys to a WebView or another host
• raw audio for storage; full transcripts unless v1 sync opt-in
• workspace A memory to Genie B (cross-workspace off)
• full B answers to memory; telemetry until OtlpTable
• voiceprints, diarization or emotion data (never made)
Diagram 9. Trust boundaries. Secrets stay in the Rust core and the OS keychain. Only the numbered data flows leave the device, and each goes only to its own profile host.
